# Vendor packages (not in git)

This folder holds third-party packages on the tester's machine only.

## Rustici golf examples (CC BY 3.0)

1. Download https://scorm.com/scorm-explained/technical-scorm/golf-examples/.
2. Keep both the SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 editions here with their license file.
3. The multi-SCO and sequencing samples exercise the module menu, rollup and the sequencing warning.

## Adapt Learning course (GPL-3.0)

1. Build a small course in a local Adapt authoring install (https://github.com/adaptlearning/adapt_authoring).
2. Export SCORM 1.2 and 2004 and place the ZIPs here.
3. It exercises a single-page app with suspend data through the pipwerks wrapper.

## Vendor exports (local only)

Storyline 360 (1.2 and 2004 4th edition), Rise 360, Captivate, iSpring and Elucidat's default export stay outside git. Elucidat's default export is a ~7 KB package that streams content from Elucidat.
